caption:
Southeast Austin has marked the grand opening of Burleson Studios, a 104-apartment supportive housing community.

Located at 7905 Burleson Road, the Foundation Communities development pairs furnished studio apartments with on-site services intended to help residents maintain stable housing.

Foundation Communities lists 24-hour on-site staff, a food pantry, computer lab and resident support services among the community’s features. An October 16 announcement describes the development as serving primarily people exiting chronic homelessness.

Why it matters locally: New housing supply serves different needs. Supportive housing combines a home with ongoing assistance for residents who may struggle to stay housed without it.

This is a completed housing milestone, rather than a proposed unit count. The grand opening does not establish how many apartments are occupied or currently available.

For eligibility, application procedures and current availability, use Foundation Communities’ official information.

Sources: Foundation Communities; FHLB Dallas grand-opening announcement, October 16, 2026.
